statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across homepage, section, article, and recovery templates.

page.notes: Public Turkish news site with advertising, recommendation, analytics, consent, section and article templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A dark-scheme capture is visually identical to the light capture; the probe reports color-scheme: normal and body background rgb(255,255,255).
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, the probe still found sticky-animation with a 7000ms duration.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit plus preference CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found 15 contrast failures and the root exposes no color-scheme/high-contrast adaptation.
Article CSS inspection found no view-transition rules while navigation is a multi-page route change.
Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked animation appeared on the audited listing/article paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited editorial reading paths expose no swipe, pull, carousel-drag, or other gesture-driven core interaction.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The long homepage has 29,834 CSS px of content, but CSS inspection found no scroll-timeline/container-scroll-state behavior and the fixed header provides no progress cue.
Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or edge-sensitive anchored popover is part of the audited core reading journey; the consent surface is a viewport modal.

checkOutcomes.method: visual review of article breadcrumb, headline, byline and section navigation
checkOutcomes.evidence: The article presents a breadcrumb, dominant headline, byline, and clearly grouped share controls.
Desktop and mobile screenshots show a modal dimming and blocking the homepage and article before any reading interaction.
DOM evidence found four DIV elements with role=dialog rather than native dialog/popover primitives, with multiple hidden H1/H2 trees injected into the page.
The blocking consent chrome consumes the central viewport and dims all editorial content.

checkOutcomes.method: mobile layout metrics on two templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: At a 360px viewport both homepage and article report scrollWidth 507px and horizontalOverflowPx 147.
The live stylesheet probe found zero container query rules while reusable cards/tickers appear at substantially different widths.
Focusing the first 20 controls produced outline-style none and no box shadow for each sampled link.
Section breadcrumb, news headline, summary and byline clearly communicate the article purpose.
The representative homepage-to-article journey cannot reach readable content without first resolving a blocking consent modal; the manage screen offers no one-click reject-all.
The 404 state names the error, explains likely causes, and offers a homepage recovery action plus news links.
Trace LCP was 7.37s; Lighthouse LCP was 4.28s with performance 60 and TBT 376ms.

checkOutcomes.method: layout shift observer and Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Observed CLS was 0.051 mobile and Lighthouse CLS 0.0076, both within the good threshold.
Trace found two ~121-123ms long tasks and Lighthouse TBT was 376ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary and DOM script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR shows 5,467,900 transferred bytes, 121 third-party requests, 2.05MB script, 3.04MB images, and multiple parser-inserted critical resources.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party payload and Lighthouse diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR attributes 4.98MB to third-party origins and shows repeated analytics/tag-manager payloads; Lighthouse TTI is 33.7s.
Lighthouse found one unnamed button, two unnamed links, and one untitled frame; the probe also sampled icon-only anchors.
Lighthouse reported 15 color-contrast failures on the loaded homepage.
Focus probes show no visible outline; the consent system injects several H1s and many H2 vendor headings alongside page headings.

checkOutcomes.method: desktop article screenshot and CSS/DOM review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article headline and summary use a clear hierarchy, generous size, and readable measure behind the consent layer.
At 360px, both tested templates overflow 147px, and the mobile consent copy/buttons extend beyond the visible layout.
Lighthouse recorded zero console-error items.
Image inspection found 90/100 without width/height, 93 without srcset, 90 legacy-format images, and 5 oversized images.
Lighthouse reported one deprecated API and notification permission requested on page load.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probes on home and article
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both templates expose unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Lighthouse found two non-crawlable anchors and one robots.txt error; the mobile layout also overflows despite a viewport meta tag.
Discoverability reported titlePresentInRaw=false and h1PresentInRaw=false for the article, with only 48% rendered-token coverage.
Article exposes NewsArticle, VideoObject, BreadcrumbList, canonical and complete Open Graph metadata matching visible content.
Header inspection found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; 14 cookies were flagged insecure.
Tracker evidence saw 50 third-party origins and 15 known trackers; HAR recorded 121 third-party requests and 4.98MB before the consent choice.
Lighthouse notification-on-start failed on the public homepage.
The main response lacked HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and CSP.
Article discoverability found only 48% content overlap and no title/H1 in raw HTML, although rendered content exists.

checkOutcomes.method: dialog, async script and 404 runtime review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested consent and 404 states render deterministically and the error path remains navigable.
DOM probes found no manifest link; the public news site exposes service-worker capability but no installability metadata in tested pages.
The missing-page state is explicit and offers recovery rather than a blank shell.
html lang is tr and live styles include logical properties; Turkish content reading order is correct.

checkOutcomes.method: rendered finance/date and structured metadata review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Currency values use Turkish separators and article times expose machine-readable ISO datetime values.
Published, created, and modified timestamps are unambiguous ISO values with +03:00 offsets.

checkOutcomes.method: consent screenshots and manage-options control inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Initial UI emphasizes “İzin ver”; manage options exposes “Tümünü kabul et” and “Seçimleri onayla” but no one-click reject-all, while describing 286 partners.
Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authored user-input form is part of the public news reading paths; the tested 404 recovery is covered separately.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: No address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other primary input form appears in the audited public reading journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: Checkout, subscription, authentication and account-management flows were outside the public editorial paths and not required to read an article.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR weight offenders plus images primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: One SVG response transfers 2,497,929 bytes; image inspection reports 90 legacy formats and 93 images without responsive sources.
The first load makes 160 requests, including 121 third-party requests and 35 fetch/XHR requests, before a consent decision.
HAR attributes 4.98MB of 5.47MB to third-party origins and 44 script requests overall.
Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: This editorial site exposes content rather than transactional capabilities; WebMCP tools would not improve the representative read-news task. Structured article data is assessed under discoverability.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Applicability was assessed during representative-path recon.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the audited public reading journey requires built-in summarisation or language-model inference; absence is not a defect.

checkOutcomes.method: baseline/post heap comparison after ten feed traversals
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten bottom/top traversals, heap summary rose from 52.6MB/916,348 nodes to 67.1MB/1,195,198 nodes; in-page used JS heap rose about 12MB even as element count fell.

checkOutcomes.method: baseline heap summary and DOM count
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 916,348 nodes and 52.6MB self size before sustained interaction.
No Detached* constructor entered either top-constructor summary; this gives medium-confidence evidence against a large detached-DOM population, though deeper listener tracing is still advisable.

principleOutcomes.reason: The audited public editorial journey has no agent-facing transactional or on-device inference capability where these emerging checks would add user value.

paths.description: Homepage and consent entry state; represents the main news listing and primary arrival journey.
Gündem section listing; represents category/index templates shared by topical sections.
Current Gündem article; represents detail/reading, metadata, crawler, and narrow-layout behavior.
Intentional missing route; represents HTTP/error recovery behavior.

findings.summary: No dark theme is provided
findings.evidence: A dark-scheme capture is visually identical to the light capture; the probe reports color-scheme: normal and body background rgb(255,255,255).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces with prefers-color-scheme/light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not remove all non-essential animation
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, the probe still found sticky-animation with a 7000ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially reduce decorative/sticky motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: Article CSS inspection found no view-transition rules while navigation is a multi-page route change.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a no-motion override.

findings.summary: Sticky chrome does not communicate scroll position
findings.evidence: The long homepage has 29,834 CSS px of content, but CSS inspection found no scroll-timeline/container-scroll-state behavior and the fixed header provides no progress cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or scroll-state-aware header treatment.

findings.summary: Consent wall obscures every primary page on load
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a modal dimming and blocking the homepage and article before any reading interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Make consent non-blocking where lawful, preserve immediate access to content, and provide equally prominent accept/reject controls.

findings.summary: Consent UI is a custom dialog stack
findings.evidence: DOM evidence found four DIV elements with role=dialog rather than native dialog/popover primitives, with multiple hidden H1/H2 trees injected into the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a single semantic dialog, correct focus management, inert background, and a clear close/reject path.

findings.summary: Mobile pages overflow by 147px
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport both homepage and article report scrollWidth 507px and horizontalOverflowPx 147.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/min widths in the consent and ticker layouts; use intrinsic sizing and max-inline-size:100%.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport sizing only
findings.evidence: The live stylesheet probe found zero container query rules while reusable cards/tickers appear at substantially different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-level breakpoints for reused cards and ticker modules.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visible
findings.evidence: Focusing the first 20 controls produced outline-style none and no box shadow for each sampled link.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and preserve it across all links and controls.

findings.summary: Reading is blocked behind consent
findings.evidence: The representative homepage-to-article journey cannot reach readable content without first resolving a blocking consent modal; the manage screen offers no one-click reject-all.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep editorial content readable while consent is pending and offer symmetric accept/reject choices.

findings.summary: Largest content appears too late
findings.evidence: Trace LCP was 7.37s; Lighthouse LCP was 4.28s with performance 60 and TBT 376ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP element, defer ads/analytics, and reduce critical dependency depth.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers 5.47MB across 160 requests
findings.evidence: HAR shows 5,467,900 transferred bytes, 121 third-party requests, 2.05MB script, 3.04MB images, and multiple parser-inserted critical resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate third parties on consent/value, defer non-critical scripts and CSS, and fix the 2.5MB SVG response.

findings.summary: Third-party and advertising code dominates the load
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 4.98MB to third-party origins and shows repeated analytics/tag-manager payloads; Lighthouse TTI is 33.7s.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics, remove duplicate tags, and load ad/recommendation code only near use.

findings.summary: Interactive controls lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found one unnamed button, two unnamed links, and one untitled frame; the probe also sampled icon-only anchors.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon link/button and iframe a concise accessible name/title.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails in multiple places
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 15 color-contrast failures on the loaded homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast in normal and dimmed states.

findings.summary: Focus treatment and heading structure are polluted by consent UI
findings.evidence: Focus probes show no visible outline; the consent system injects several H1s and many H2 vendor headings alongside page headings.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore visible focus and isolate the active dialog heading structure from hidden preference panels.

findings.summary: The mobile/reflow view is clipped
findings.evidence: At 360px, both tested templates overflow 147px, and the mobile consent copy/buttons extend beyond the visible layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the consent and ticker reflow at 320-400px and verify at 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Most images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive sources
findings.evidence: Image inspection found 90/100 without width/height, 93 without srcset, 90 legacy-format images, and 5 oversized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height, srcset/sizes, and modern encoded variants for editorial images.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and an unsolicited notification prompt are present
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported one deprecated API and notification permission requested on page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API use and request notifications only after an explicit user action.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable and robots validation fails
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two non-crawlable anchors and one robots.txt error; the mobile layout also overflows despite a viewport meta tag.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href targets, repair robots.txt delivery/content, and remove mobile overflow.

findings.summary: Article raw HTML omits key indexing signals under the crawler path
findings.evidence: Discoverability reported titlePresentInRaw=false and h1PresentInRaw=false for the article, with only 48% rendered-token coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure article title, H1, canonical metadata, and body are consistently present in the first server response to crawler UAs.

findings.summary: Baseline security headers and secure cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; 14 cookies were flagged insecure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer and permissions policies; mark HTTPS cookies Secure with appropriate SameSite.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before consent across a very large vendor surface
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence saw 50 third-party origins and 15 known trackers; HAR recorded 121 third-party requests and 4.98MB before the consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential analytics/ad requests until consent, reduce vendors, and document a strict data-minimisation budget.

findings.summary: Notification permission is requested on page load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse notification-on-start failed on the public homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Ask for notification permission only after a clear subscribe action and explanation.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent
findings.evidence: The main response lacked HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and a nonce/hash-based CSP.

findings.summary: Crawler/no-JS article delivery is incomplete
findings.evidence: Article discoverability found only 48% content overlap and no title/H1 in raw HTML, although rendered content exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the complete article heading and body and enhance it with JavaScript rather than depending on client completion.

findings.summary: No installable/offline entry point is exposed
findings.evidence: DOM probes found no manifest link; the public news site exposes service-worker capability but no installability metadata in tested pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a web app manifest and a small offline fallback for previously visited/public news content.

findings.summary: Consent choices are asymmetric
findings.evidence: Initial UI emphasizes “İzin ver”; manage options exposes “Tümünü kabul et” and “Seçimleri onayla” but no one-click reject-all, while describing 286 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide an equally prominent reject-all beside accept-all and avoid loading non-essential vendors before a choice.

findings.summary: Asset delivery is wasteful for an editorial homepage
findings.evidence: One SVG response transfers 2,497,929 bytes; image inspection reports 90 legacy formats and 93 images without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the anomalous SVG response and serve responsive AVIF/WebP editorial images.

findings.summary: Background advertising and analytics work is disproportionate
findings.evidence: The first load makes 160 requests, including 121 third-party requests and 35 fetch/XHR requests, before a consent decision.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritize and gate background fetching; remove duplicate measurement and bidder work.

findings.summary: Third-party payload exceeds the first-party payload by an order of magnitude
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 4.98MB of 5.47MB to third-party origins and 44 script requests overall.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party byte/request budget and defer low-value media/ad integrations.

findings.summary: Memory grows materially after repeated feed traversal
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top traversals, heap summary rose from 52.6MB/916,348 nodes to 67.1MB/1,195,198 nodes; in-page used JS heap rose about 12MB even as element count fell.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile retained closures/listeners from ad and feed integrations; release observers, timers, and caches after content/consent state changes.

findings.summary: Initial heap footprint is heavy for a news listing
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 916,348 nodes and 52.6MB self size before sustained interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party runtimes and DOM/card volume; virtualize or defer below-fold modules.

taskList.title: Make consent symmetric, non-blocking, and privacy-preserving
Gate and remove low-value third-party/ad payload
Fix mobile overflow and visible keyboard focus
Deploy baseline security headers and secure cookie policy
Repair accessible names, contrast, and dialog semantics
Optimize image delivery and the anomalous 2.5MB SVG
Investigate retained memory growth after feed traversal
